T3a's population-aggregate direction runs OPPOSITE the pre-registered hypothesis on MFE: events with a dilution filing before t0 show a HIGHER median MFE cost-multiple at every horizon (e.g. 15min: 2.00 vs 1.53 without), not lower. MAE is also higher for the filing group at every horizon (15min: 2.20 vs 1.95) -- both legs move together, consistent with 'a dilution filing marks a more volatile/eventful stock' rather than the specific asymmetric worsening the proposal predicted. Stated as a population-aggregate observation, not cross-cut by year/decile (see charts 03 for that) and explicitly not a verdict -- no kill condition exists to fail.

T3b (undirected) shows the largest population-aggregate separation of the three splits: median MFE cost-multiple at 15min is 0.91 (below-median turnover) vs 2.67 (above-median turnover), roughly 3x. T3c (undirected) shows almost none: 1.60 vs 1.70 at 15min. Both reported as distributions only.
